result.topic_en: A table of timed observations of decreasing oscillation amplitudes (scale readings) with their common logarithms, grouped in fives with mean logarithms, used to determine the logarithmic decrement of a damped magnetometer needle under open and closed circuit conditions in an induction experiment.

methods.what: Common logarithms of oscillation amplitudes taken and averaged over groups of five successive readings
Mean of logarithms of five readings (group mean)
Logarithmic decrement with open circuit obtained from difference of group means (2.93777 - 2.92001, over 16 swings, in units of 1e-5)
Logarithmic decrement with closed circuit from difference of group means (2.88612 - 2.78078, over 16 swings)
